message.content: The most iconic sculpture of the 19th century is **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (1889). It epitomizes the era’s shift toward expressive, emotionally charged forms and remains one of the most reproduced and celebrated works of art from that period.
